temporal.note: any fortnight with Sentinel coverage; date is a run param

about.description: Water vs non-water for a single fortnight, from raw Sentinel-1 SAR + Sentinel-2 optical composited around a target date.
about.intended_use: Which pixels held water on a given fortnight (e.g. 14 Jul) — the intra-annual water-seasonality signal the annual embedding can't give.
about.limitations: One fortnight at a time; needs a cloud-lite S2 scene in the window; linear model, so it trades some accuracy for band-math serving.
about.evidence: Small vs large water bodies (deployed S1+S2 model, week11/water_eval.py, threshold 1.4 ha): small water P 0.85/R 0.67/F1 0.75, large P 1.00/R 0.97/F1 0.99; dryland false-positive (spurious water) rate 0.02. | EE GT (week11/water_gt_eval.py, 2024): with a 2-fortnight persistence filter, GT_BINARY water P 0.96/R 0.41/F1 0.58, spurious (non-water called water) 0.02; small-water recall 0.11 vs large 0.77. Raising the threshold cuts spurious detections at some cost to small/seasonal recall.
